story.text: Friday, Via Falchi. The VR expert tries the headset on Martino, the farm's chihuahua. He panics and bolts past the olive trees. Nonna saw everything, and she blames the guests.
Saturday. Martino's tracks lead into the woods. Something big struts between the trees, and it has a VR strap tangled in its tail.
Sunday, Venice. The headset has been running on Martino's head for two days. The thing barking at pigeons in the campo is still him. Probably.
The headset falls off. Martino shrinks, shakes himself, and licks the nearest ankle. Martino saved.
